thread:
alex_sales: FinLedger POC hitting 429s when they run concurrent embedding jobs (~50 concurrent). Demo tomorrow at 15:00 PT — can we triage urgently? They attached sample request IDs.

sarah_poc_owner: On it. Any details on batch size and route?

matt_engineer: They call POST /v1/embeddings with large batches (512 inputs). Initial look: per-route cap set low for safety. Will pull logs.

tera_support: I see requests: req_ka9, req_kaA, req_kb2. Sample 429: "quota_exceeded: per_route_rate_limit" at 1955001208.

matt_engineer: Confirmed. Tenant global cap = 200 rps, route cap = 60 rps. With big batches each call consumes many tokens and spikes concurrent processing.

alex_sales: Customer pasted their curl: 
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <KEY>' 
  -d '{"input": [...512 strings...] }'

amelia_devex: If they batch 512 we multiply token footprint. Quick wins: 1) split into 64-128 batches, 2) enable client-side rate smoothing/backoff, 3) consider async client batching or streaming.

devops_bot: autoscaler: Observed spike at 1955001205 -> scaled up 3 GPUs (cooldown 120s).

matt_engineer: Action items: (1) Temporary per-route cap bump for finledger-tenant for demo window, (2) recommend client changes and sample code. I can apply #1 if sales approves.

alex_sales: :thumbsup: Please apply. Also pricing question — will the demo overage be charged? Customer expects a small grace for the live demo.

sarah_poc_owner: Finance approved limited grace for demo (up to $200). I'll create a manual quota exception for the demo window.

tera_support: Applied rule finledger-demo-bump at 1955001250: per-route cap = 300 rps for 2 hours. Monitoring now.

matt_engineer: 429s stopped after bump but latency rose to ~420ms. Recommend smoothing policy to flatten bursts. Example config snippet to suggest to infra team:
```json
{"route":"/v1/embeddings","rate_limit":{"mode":"token_bucket","burst":120,"window_s":1}}
```

amelia_devex: I'll send client-side patch to FinLedger: reduce batch->128, add exponential backoff (100-200ms jitter), and switch to streaming if possible.

alex_sales: Customer accepted recommended client changes. Can we keep the demo bump until 23:59 PT today? Demo at 15:00 PT.

matt_engineer: We'll keep the bump until 23:59 PT and monitor. After demo we'll follow up to set stable quotas and pricing.

tera_support: No new 429s in the last 10m. Will rollback finledger-demo-bump at 23:59 unless requested. Closing loop unless someone objects. :white_check_mark:
